1.why: Every screen is static with a plain light background, no animations, carousels, or pop-ups visible.

2.why: The active step is a solid dark-blue pill, primary buttons are high-contrast blue, and success banners use a distinct green bar.

3.why: A persistent 7-step progress bar, numbered headings, and a single primary action per view make the next needed control immediately findable.

4.why: Each screen presents only one discrete action; the stepper and on-screen reminders eliminate any need to memorize prior rules or steps.

5.why: No password-manager affordance, autofill hint, or “remember me” checkbox appears on any of the credential-entry screens.

6.why: Previously entered values (email, tokens, codes) are restored and pre-filled in later fields, letting the user recognize familiar data.

7.why: All labels and instructions are short, plain-language sentences with ample white space and no dense paragraphs.

8.why: Only success banners are shown; no error-state messages that describe a problem and how to fix it appear in the provided screenshots.

9.why: Password rules are stated in text and mock tokens are pre-filled, yet no inline format examples (e.g., “name@example.com”) are supplied for empty fields.

10.why: The flow offers only password-plus-code entry; no alternative choices such as face login or other authenticators are presented.

11.why: Each step isolates a single decision or input, never presenting a list of competing options simultaneously.

12.why: Every action is followed by an explicit green confirmation banner that states the outcome and the next required step.

13.why: Contextual guidance (“Paste or type the testing mock reset token”, password-composition rules, “You can pause…”) appears beside new fields.

14.why: Fields remain editable after confirmation and the user can re-enter values; the design implies easy retry even though an explicit “try again” link is not shown.

15.why: Identical layout, typography, button style, stepper, and log panel are maintained across all twelve screens, enabling consistent learning.
